uncertainty: Company-cluster 95% percentile intervals are reported only when the frozen floor of >=60 matched events, >=20 companies and >=800 finite draws is met. Every baseline cell is below that floor, so ci95 bounds are null (unavailable), not zero. Pointwise; not simultaneous; not causal. A strategy or horizon must never be selected by largest point estimate.
